description: Locked Mise editorial illustration recipe. The approved broccoli is the gold master. appliance.note: Colour is part of the brief. The shared appliance style asks for material-accurate colour, which resolves every appliance to brushed steel unless the subject names its own palette. The concept calls for coloured cookware in the Mise palette — sage, olive, cream, slate, terracotta.
